senses.gloss: गृ॑भ् f. (only acc. गृ॑भम् instr. गृभा abl. ˚भ॑स्; for dat. ˚भे॑ See √ ग्रह्) grasping, seizing, RV. vii, 4, 3; viii, 17, 15; VS. xxi, 43
गृ॑भ् mfn. ‘grasping’ ifc. See जीव-, सुते-, स्यूम-गृ॑भ्.
गृभ॑ m. (= गृह॑) dwelling-place, RV. vii, 21, 2.
गृभ॑यत् mfn. (irr. pr. p.) seizing, i, 148, 3.

गृभाय Nom. P. ˚य॑ति (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 84 and Vārtt.; only Impv. ˚य॑ and ˚य॑त; cf. अनु-, आ-सं-, उद्-, प्रति-, सं-, सम्-आ-√ ग्रह्; fr. गृभाय are to be derived the forms of √ ग्रह् (q.v.) beginning with गृभी, ग्रभी, गृही, ग्रही), to grasp, seize, RV. vii, 104, 18; viii, 17, 5 and 69, 10; AV. ii.
गृ॑भि mfn. (cf. ग॑र्भ) holding, containing (with gen.), AV. xii, 1, 57 (cf. प॑ड्-; दुर्-गृ॑भि.)
गृभित mfn. grasped, seized, BhP. iii, 21, 24.
गृभीत॑ mfn. (= गृहीत॑) id., RV.; VS. xvii, 55; BhP. x, 87, 14
(cf. गृ॑भि) impregnated, bearing fruit, AitBr. ii, 1, 6.
गृभीत॑—ताति (˚त॑-), f. the being seized, RV. v, 74, 4.
